messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Fluoxetine is FDA-approved to treat the following conditions:
- Major depressive disorder (MDD) for acute and maintenance treatment in adults and children aged 8 years and older
- Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) for acute and maintenance treatment in adults and children aged 7 years and older
- Bulimia nervosa for acute and maintenance treatment of binge-eating and purging in adults with moderate to severe bulimia
- Panic disorder for the treatment of panic attacks in adults
When used in combination with olanzapine, fluoxetine is also FDA-approved for:
- Acute treatment of depressive episodes associated with Bipolar I disorder (depressive episodes) in adults and children aged 10 years and older
- Treatment-resistant depression for adults who have not responded to at least two adequate antidepressant trials
Fluoxetine alone is not approved for bipolar I depressive episodes or treatment-resistant depression - olanzapine must be used in combination for these indications.
Triplet: ["fluoxetine and olanzapine", "treats treatment resistant depression", "in adults who have not responded to at least two adequate antidepressant trials"]

The relation 'treats treatment resistant depression' in the triplet is defined as 'The combination of the subject and object drugs is FDA-approved to treat treatment-resistant depression in adults who have not responded to at least two adequate antidepressant trials.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in combination with': The subject drug is used together with the other treatment or lifestyle measure specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
E. 'has accelerated approval for': The subject drug is approved for use in treating the specified condition under accelerated regulatory pathways, typically based on limited or early evidence.
